item.title: How to pace your first half marathon
item.description: A practical pacing plan for your first 21.1 km — how to pick a realistic goal pace, split the race into thirds, and avoid the classic 15 km fade.

item.title: Why running posture matters more than mileage
item.description: Cadence, torso lean, and arm carriage change how much load each step puts through your legs. Here is what to look for when you film yourself running.
